email.subject1: a signal play for Super Dispatch
email.body1:
Emily, saw Super Dispatch released its second State of Auto Transport Report and rolled out Instant Transfer payments.

With nearly a million vehicles moving monthly, there are likely more in-market accounts than the team can cover. That is where pipeline goes cold: reps spend hours on research, writing, and CRM instead of meetings. Our AI SDR runs all of that autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, around 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Super Dispatch off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Emily, quick follow-up for Super Dispatch.

As you scale the marketplace, the addressable carrier and broker base outgrows what the team can cover at current capacity. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit target, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Super Dispatch needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Emily, last bit of proof for Super Dispatch.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Super Dispatch's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Emily, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't the priority this quarter, no problem at all. With the report and payments work in flight, the team is plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your marketplace motion? I'll tailor it to Super Dispatch either way, and it's yours regardless.
